entries.text: Welcome to the Montenevera Gym! Would you\nlike me to explain the Gym Test rules again?
entries.label: gym_ghost_020_receptionist_01

entries.text: Your test here at the Montenevera Gym is to\nwarm up the audience for the main event!\r\nThat’s right—you’re the [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]opening act[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]!
entries.label: gym_ghost_020_receptionist_02

entries.text: You’ll need to get up on stage, show us some\ndead fierce Pokémon battles, and get the crowd\r\nexcited before the Gym Leader’s concert begins!
entries.label: gym_ghost_020_receptionist_03

entries.text: You can start the Gym Test by speaking with\nMC Sledge in front of the stage outside.
entries.label: gym_ghost_020_receptionist_04

entries.text: Yo, Trainer! You the one performin’ the opening\nact today? My name’s MC Sledge! This is the\r\nstage right here![VAR 0x0114(003B)]
entries.label: gym_ghost_020_mc_01

entries.text: So here’s the deal. We’re gonna have you do\nsome Double Battles! That’s where you have two\r\nPokémon fight on each side.[VAR 0x0114(003B)]
entries.label: gym_ghost_020_mc_02

entries.text: [EMPTY 55]
entries.label: gym_ghost_020_mc_03

entries.text: That’ll let you sledge up double the opponents\nand get the audience twice as excited! The venue\r\nwill be so hot, it’ll melt the Montenevera snow![VAR 0x0114(003B)]
entries.label: gym_ghost_020_mc_04

entries.text: Once you get the audience worked up and ready\nto go, that’ll be the cue for our leader to take the\r\nstage! That’s how you pass our Gym Test, yo![VAR 0x0114(003B)]
entries.label: gym_ghost_020_mc_05

entries.text: Your opening act begins as soon as you get up on\nstage! There’ll be no backing down until you win\r\nthree times in a row, so make sure you’re ready![VAR 0x0114(003B)]
entries.label: gym_ghost_020_mc_19

entries.text: You good on the deets for the opening act and\nour Gym Test? Ready to sledge ’em up?![VAR 0x0114(003B)]
entries.label: gym_ghost_020_mc_06

entries.text: Yep! I’m ready!
entries.label: gym_ghost_020_select_01

entries.text: Not yet
entries.label: gym_ghost_020_select_02

entries.text: Could you explain again?
entries.label: gym_ghost_020_select_03

entries.text: Hey now! You’re gonna need two Pokémon for\nthis Gym Test, yo![VAR 0x0114(003B)]
entries.label: gym_ghost_020_mc_no_double

entries.text: I feel ya. Openin’ for Ryme is no easy task! Make\nsure you’re ready to go before we start![VAR 0x0114(003B)]
entries.label: gym_ghost_020_mc_cancel

entries.text: Sweet! Just play it by ear—you’ll do great! Head\non up to the stage![VAR 0x0114(003B)]
entries.label: gym_ghost_020_mc_07

entries.text: What’s up, Monteneveraaa! Today’s opening act\nwill be three back-to-back Double Battles by our\r\nchallenger here, [VAR 0x0100(0000)]![VAR 0x0114(003B)]
entries.label: gym_ghost_020_mc_20

entries.text: And the first of their three opponents will be a\nyoung performer who makes it look like a breeze![VAR 0x0114(003B)]
entries.label: gym_ghost_020_mc_21

entries.text: The one, the only...Tas![VAR 0x0114(003B)]
entries.label: gym_ghost_020_mc_30

entries.text: Double Battles—that means one plus one, right?\nCan you do that math?
entries.label: gym_ghost_020_boy_01

entries.text: [EMPTY 55]
entries.label: gym_ghost_020_mc_08

entries.text: [EMPTY 55]
entries.label: gym_ghost_020_mc_09

entries.text: [EMPTY 55]
entries.label: gym_ghost_020_mc_10

entries.text: [EMPTY 55]

entries.label: gym_ghost_020_poke_01

entries.text: The audience’s cheering got a little louder!
entries.label: gym_ghost_020_system_01

entries.text: The Montenevera stage has all the latest tech!\nThe more excited the audience gets, the more\r\nthe stage will light up![VAR 0x0114(003B)]
entries.label: gym_ghost_020_mc_22

entries.text: Keep on sledgin’! You got this![VAR 0x0114(003B)]
entries.label: gym_ghost_020_mc_23

entries.text: Aaand our challenger’s next opponent will be a\nmusician with a bit of a unique style...[VAR 0x0114(003B)]
entries.label: gym_ghost_020_mc_24

entries.text: Iiit’s Lani![VAR 0x0114(003B)]
entries.label: gym_ghost_020_mc_25

entries.text: Strong complements weak! The harmony of two\nPokémon battling in unison!
entries.label: gym_ghost_020_musician_01

entries.text: The audience is really getting excited!
entries.label: gym_ghost_020_system_02

entries.text: Your opening act’s turned the cheering AND the\nstage lighting up to 11![VAR 0x0114(003B)]
entries.label: gym_ghost_020_mc_26

entries.text: What a surprise from our new challenger! Who’d\nhave thought they’d sledge it up this much?![VAR 0x0114(003B)]
entries.label: gym_ghost_020_mc_27

entries.text: Next is your last opponent. And it’s none other\nthan...[VAR 0x0114(003B)]
entries.label: gym_ghost_020_mc_28

entries.text: ME! MC Sledge![VAR 0x0114(003B)]
entries.label: gym_ghost_020_mc_29

entries.text: Bein’ an MC isn’t my only forte—I can battle too!\nI’ll sledge ya up real good in a Double Battle![VAR 0x0114(003B)]
entries.label: gym_ghost_020_mc_31

entries.text: The audience’s excitement has reached a fever\npitch!
entries.label: gym_ghost_020_system_03

entries.text: Whoa! Awesome! That was a great battle!
entries.label: gym_ghost_020_mobs_01

entries.text: How lucky! That was a rare sight!
entries.label: gym_ghost_020_mobs_02

entries.text: Thank yooou, [VAR 0x0100(0000)]!\c\nCongratulations, you passed the Gym Test! Give\n’em a round of applause, everybody![VAR 0x0114(003B)]
entries.label: gym_ghost_020_mc_13

entries.text: I feel a scary-good sense of unity in the crowd!\nPerfecto! We’re ready to go for the main event![VAR 0x0114(003B)]
entries.label: gym_ghost_020_mc_14

entries.text: C’mon, everybody—say it with me! This is what\nyou’ve all been waitin’ for...[VAR 0x0114(003B)]
entries.label: gym_ghost_020_mc_15

entries.text: Give it up for the MC of RIP! Ryyyyyyyyyme![VAR 0x0114(003B)]
entries.label: gym_ghost_020_mc_16

entries.text: Ryme! Ryme! Ryme! Ryme! Ryme! Ryme!
entries.label: gym_ghost_020_mobs_03

entries.text: What’s all this noise I’m hearin’?![VAR 0x0114(001B)]
entries.label: gym_ghost_020_ghost_01

entries.text: This crowd’s so loud, it could wake the dead...[VAR 0x0114(001B)]
entries.label: gym_ghost_020_ghost_02

entries.text: Lemme tell ya what I wanna hear—y’all feelin’\ngood?![VAR 0x0114(001B)]
entries.label: gym_ghost_020_ghost_03

entries.text: Yeah! We’re feelin’ good! Ryme! Ryme! Ryme!\nRyme! Woooooo!
entries.label: gym_ghost_020_mobs_04

entries.text: Thanks for the killer opener, baby! Now I’ll get\nthis started for real.[VAR 0x0114(001B)]
entries.label: gym_ghost_020_ghost_04

entries.text: Congrats on the Gym Test! That was sick, yo.\nThanks![VAR 0x0114(003B)]
entries.label: gym_ghost_020_mc_17

entries.text: Give us a min for some Ryme time, ya feel me?\nGo ahead and tell the lobby staffer you passed.[VAR 0x0114(003B)]
entries.label: gym_ghost_020_mc_18

entries.text: The audience is enthralled by the Gym Leader!\nGo talk to the lobby staffer!
entries.label: gym_ghost_020_stopper_01
